svg.text: Bench wiring: Raspberry Pi 5, NUCLEO-F446RE, 2 x CAN transceiver, MPU6050, advisory LEDs
Board drawings: Fritzing parts library (Raspberry Pi 4B, Nucleo-64, GY-521), CC-BY-SA 3.0.
CAN modules, breadboard, resistors and LEDs drawn by tools/wiring_diagram. Positions on the
breadboard are illustrative; every connection matches the bench pin table.
Wires (pin names as on the NUCLEO silkscreen / CN10 morpho)
Pi pin 8 GPIO14 TXD → D2 = PA10 USART1 RX
Pi pin 10 GPIO15 RXD ← D8 = PA9 USART1 TX
GND (Pi pin 6 → CN5 GND; rails; modules; LED cathodes)
D14 = PB9 CAN1 TX → CAN #1 CTX
D15 = PB8 CAN1 RX ← CAN #1 CRX
CN10-30 = PB13 CAN2 TX → CAN #2 CTX
CN10-16 = PB12 CAN2 RX ← CAN #2 CRX
D10 = PB6 I2C1 SCL → MPU6050 SCL
CN7-21 = PB7 I2C1 SDA ↔ MPU6050 SDA
D4 = PB5 → 330 Ω → green LED: CLEAR (NONE)
D5 = PB4 → 330 Ω → yellow LED: JUMP; blink = UNCERTAIN
D6 = PB10 → 330 Ω → red LED: STOP; blink = no Pi data
D9 = PC7 → 150 Ω → blue LED: UNCERTAIN
